metadata.description: Conaltura's fork of johnnyvizz/claude-kit: the Claude Code mods of TI's standard (savvy-progress with the crew, next-steps).

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: Skill: plan, delegate to tiered worker subagents, review.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Mod: agents panel with Conaltura's crew in pixel art, in the terminal and the desktop, and a progress band for each batch of agents.

plugins.name: session-band
plugins.description: Mod: band above the prompt with turn, speed, cost, prompt cache countdown and context; notifies before the cache expires.

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Mod: after each turn, suggests up to three next prompts above the input (from anthropics/claude-plugins-community, commit 06ec7b6, MIT).
